== Template:Item/Weapon ==

Master template for displaying complete weapon tooltips. Combines header, stats, vitals, resists, weapon stats, DPS, class restrictions, and optional proc effects.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Description
|-
| '''image''' || Yes || Item icon image filename
|-
| '''name''' || Yes || Weapon name
|-
| '''type''' || Yes || Weapon slot: Primary, Secondary, Primary or Secondary, Primary - 2-Handed
|-
| '''two_handed''' || No || Set for two-handed melee weapons, staffs, and bows
|-
| '''tier''' || No || Quality tier: 0=Normal (default), 1=Blessed, 2=Godly
|-
| '''relic''' || No || Set to any value for relic items
|-
| '''damage''' || No || Weapon damage value
|-
| '''delay''' || No || Attack delay in seconds
|-
| '''range''' || No || Weapon range (>1 for ranged weapons)
|-
| '''str, end, dex, agi, int, wis, cha''' || No || Stat modifiers (default: 0)
|-
| '''res''' || No || Resonance modifier (default: 0)
|-
| '''health, mana, armor''' || No || Vital modifiers (default: 0)
|-
| '''magic, poison, elemental, void''' || No || Resist modifiers (default: 0)
|-
| '''description''' || No || Flavor text
|-
| '''arcanist, duelist, druid, paladin, reaver, stormcaller''' || No || Class restrictions (set to any value)
|-
| '''proc_chance''' || No || Proc chance percentage (e.g., 10)
|-
| '''proc_style''' || No || Proc trigger: Attack (default), Bash (shields), Cast (bracers)
|-
| '''proc_spell_name''' || No || If set, displays spell effect details
|-
| '''proc_*''' || No || Various proc parameters (see Item/SpellDetails)
|}

=== Examples ===

==== Basic Weapon (No Proc) ====

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Weapon
|image=Copper Sword.png
|name=Copper Sword
|type=Primary or Secondary
|tier=0
|damage=8
|delay=1.5
|description=A standard copper sword.
|arcanist=1
|duelist=1
|druid=1
|paladin=1
|stormcaller=1
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/Weapon
|image=Copper Sword.png
|name=Copper Sword
|type=Primary or Secondary
|tier=0
|damage=8
|delay=1.5
|description=A standard copper sword.
|arcanist=1
|duelist=1
|druid=1
|paladin=1
|stormcaller=1
}}
